items.expected: Genuine same-environment comparison of complete neutral-singlet SNaft establishes a low-energy V-like basin or near-degenerate V pair below the Z-like geometry in vacuo. An unresolved or reversed preference does not meet this target. Structures and relative energetic definition must substantiate the finding; source family names are not a substitute for evidence. Physical comparison: Full neutral-singlet SNaft35atoms and SAntr41atoms; compare in-vacuo and methanol molecular settings separately. The historical reference used R2SCAN geometries and separate omegaB97M-V densities; these are provenance, not mandatory method choices. Establish each quantity with a physically comparable and internally consistent model. RelativeE and relativeG are different observables; a finite constrained scan is not a saddle-point barrier. Report the actual within-vacuum relative energies in kcal/mol, the conformer geometries and a consistent reference; merely naming V below Z is insufficient. Retain unresolved V-pair splitting without equating it with an unresolved V-versus-Z preference.

Genuine matched methanol comparison of complete neutral-singlet SNaft establishes the V-like preference over Z-like geometry. An unresolved or reversed preference does not meet this target. Do not mix vacuum and methanol energies or electronic and Gibbs quantities. Physical comparison: Full neutral-singlet SNaft35atoms and SAntr41atoms; compare in-vacuo and methanol molecular settings separately. The historical reference used R2SCAN geometries and separate omegaB97M-V densities; these are provenance, not mandatory method choices. Establish each quantity with a physically comparable and internally consistent model. RelativeE and relativeG are different observables; a finite constrained scan is not a saddle-point barrier. Report the actual within-methanol relative energies in kcal/mol and explicitly compare the magnitude and direction of the corresponding family gap with vacuum using the same observable definition. Merely repeating V below Z in both media is insufficient. No new numerical gap target is imposed, and unresolved small V-pair splitting must be retained.

items.statement: SNaft weak intramolecular aromatic C–H···O contact
items.expected: Geometry and actual electronic/interaction evidence for SNaft support a weak closed-shell aromatic C–H···O contact in V-like conformations. QTAIM is eligible but not compulsory; a BCP or short distance alone does not quantify total conformational stabilization. Physical comparison: Full neutral-singlet SNaft35atoms and SAntr41atoms; compare in-vacuo and methanol molecular settings separately. The historical reference used R2SCAN geometries and separate omegaB97M-V densities; these are provenance, not mandatory method choices. Establish each quantity with a physically comparable and internally consistent model. RelativeE and relativeG are different observables; a finite constrained scan is not a saddle-point barrier. Explain how this weak local contact is consistent with the conformational preference without asserting that its empirical energy alone equals or proves the whole conformer stabilization. Equivalent physically supported interaction explanations pass.

Actual path or accessible-configuration evidence for SNaft supports finite torsional access among V-like andZ-like states with a nonzero energy penalty, without claiming a coarse scan maximum is a verified transition-state rate. Source6–7kcal/mol finite rotational scale is context, not a compulsory continuous barrier target. Physical comparison: Full neutral-singlet SNaft35atoms and SAntr41atoms; compare in-vacuo and methanol molecular settings separately. The historical reference used R2SCAN geometries and separate omegaB97M-V densities; these are provenance, not mandatory method choices. Establish each quantity with a physically comparable and internally consistent model. RelativeE and relativeG are different observables; a finite constrained scan is not a saddle-point barrier. The final conclusion relates the finite torsional access to the local interaction: the preferred conformer is not permanently locked by that contact. This does not quantify a rate. The conclusion must be supported by quantitative energies in kcal/mol along mapped torsional configurations or a connected path, with medium, energy reference and constraint/release status stated. Identify the configurations reached and the sampled energetic cost; an unspecified nonzero penalty or an isolated displaced structure is insufficient. No particular scan mesh, numerical peak target or TS search is added.
